warning: SYNTHETIC fixture. Assertions are copied from the reviewed baseline, not from implementation observations.

scenarios.intent: The public health probe reports ok.
A valid title, priority, and body creates an open ticket.
Omitting the optional body is stored as an empty string. This is a reviewed acceptance, not a value read from the store.
A non-string title is rejected.
A priority outside low, normal, and high is rejected.
preconditions: title is a non-empty string within the approved length

scenarios.intent: A missing priority is rejected.
A non-string body is rejected.
A one-character title is the shortest accepted title.
An empty title is rejected.
An 80-character title is the longest accepted title.
An 81-character title is rejected.
A 500-character body is the longest accepted body.
A 501-character body is rejected.
Reading a ticket without a bearer token is rejected.
Reading a ticket with the wrong bearer token is rejected.
preconditions: the supplied token is not the approved synthetic credential

scenarios.intent: The ticket returned by create can be read with the approved bearer token.
preconditions: read requires the approved bearer token

scenarios.intent: An unknown ticket id is not found when the caller is authorized.
preconditions: request uses the approved bearer token

scenarios.intent: Updating a ticket without a bearer token is rejected.
A status other than open or closed is rejected.
preconditions: request uses the approved bearer token

scenarios.intent: An authorized caller can close a ticket without changing its other fields.
preconditions: update requires the approved bearer token

scenarios.intent: Closing an unknown ticket id is not found when the status is valid.
preconditions: request uses the approved bearer token
